name: Viaz Tyres Ltd.
summary: Viaz Tyres Ltd. is an Indian manufacturer specializing in a range of rubber products, primarily tyres and tubes, for various vehicle segments. The company's core product portfolio includes bicycle tyres, bicycle butyl moulded tubes, and rubber tubes for two and three-wheelers, passenger vehicles, light commercial vehicles, off-the-road vehicles, industrial, and farm equipment. Additionally, Viaz Tyres offers ancillary products such as lubricants, grease, tubeless tyre kits, and multipurpose air pumps. The company operates in a single business segment focused on the manufacturing and selling of tubes and tyres. Viaz Tyres serves both the domestic Indian market through a dealer network and exports its products to international markets, including countries in Africa, the Middle East, and Asia, as well as the USA, Brazil, and Colombia. The company caters to the replacement market and supplies to Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs). Viaz Tyres is also expanding its operations into full tyre manufacturing, with a new facility in Gujarat expected to commence operations in 2026, which will produce tyres for two-wheelers, three-wheelers, light commercial vehicles, and agricultural vehicles.
